##


Roblox’s Animal Hospital Classes: In-game Role & Ideas for OC Maker


#


Inside[Roblox Animal Hospital Anomaly](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-characters) , the closest thing to an official character maker is[the Class system](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Classes) , which players treat as their in-game identity and their role in the hospital. Each Animal Hospital Class changes your avatar’s uniform and equips you with unique abilities, stat boosts or starter items to survive hospital shifts.


The game currently features **11 distinct classes** , which you can unlock from the yellow “Classes” circle in the lobby, or buy them with Animal Coins earned from completed shifts or Robux (Roblox currency).


**Free-to-Play** (Animal Coins):


- *Intern* (starter, no cost) has no special ability beyond scaling sanity.
- *Nurse* (20 coins) adds inventory capacity per level.
- *Secretary* (120 coins) recovers sanity on every patient check-in, plus a flat sanity bonus.
- *Paramedic* (250 coins) starts with a Speed Cola for a temporary, non-stacking speed boost.
- *Psychologist* (500 coins) doubles all sanity gains *and* losses, with a chance to block sanity loss entirely at max level.
- *Doctor* (900 coins) recovers sanity on every heal, with a scaling bonus.
- *Firefighter* (1,100 coins), added in the latest update on July 25th, equips players with a rechargeable fire extinguisher.
- *Security* (1,250 coins) gives you an[X-Taser](https://animal-hospital.fandom.com/wiki/Taser) to defend against anomalies, and high Starter Money.
- *Surgeon* (2,500 coins), the priciest free-to-earn class, upgrades that same heal-for-sanity loop with a stacking speed boost and doubled sanity at level 3.


**Pay-to-play** (Robux):


- *Head Nurse* : a premium S-tier class unlocked with 190 Robux, gives a massive inventory boost and instant-healing perks.
- *Secret Agent* : a strong sanity-based class that costs between 360 and 890 Robux and best class for survival strategies, giving you powerful weapons to combat anomalies.


Major updates have introduced new skins for roles like the *Intern* , *Nurse* , *Secret Agent* , and *Psychologist* .


**Animal Hospital classes** or skins change how your character looks, which is the closest thing to shaping your **Animal Hospital OC ideas** within the game, not a real character with personality and story. An Animal Hospital Character Maker – like **Redbean** (free-to-play on iOS & Android), can turn that idea into an OC with a name, persona, lore, or even *a playable OC in its own world.*

##


Animal Hospital Roblox OC Maker: Customize Your Roblox Avatar


#


The second path is your **Roblox avatar** rather than your in-shift Animal Hospital classes, and this is closer to what most people mean by “ *Animal Hospital Roblox OC* “: a character that looks like it belongs in the hospital, that you can screenshot, pose, and use across other Roblox games.


Robox as an Animal Hospital OC Maker allows you to recreate a character from *Animal Hospital* (like Ratthew, Barney, Liz, or a hospital staff) or your custom Roblox OC/avatar: combine the right body base, custom layered clothing, and specific accessories from the[Roblox Marketplace](https://www.roblox.com/catalog) or[Catalog Avatar Creator](https://www.roblox.com/games/7041939546/Catalog-Avatar-Creator) (You can only buy them using **Robux** ).


For example, you can get a “[3D Ratthew](https://www.roblox.com/bundles/154639907343676/Ratthew-Animal-Hospital-Work-2D-3D-Clothing) ” from Animal Hospital with matching gloves, tail, ears for 175 Robux, or browse individual components and accessories from fan-made “Animal Hospital Outfits” or “Animal Hospital Avatars”. This is the fastest way to build an Animal Hospital Roblox OC look rather than drawing it yourself from scratch.


The honest limit: an avatar outfit changes how your character looks, not *who they are* – they won’t talk back, remember what you told it, or have a distinct personality. If what you actually want is a **real interactive character** , not just a look or a loadout, the next step can happen in ***[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-cozy-life-sim-with-your-own-characters)*** – an Animal Hospital OC Maker that helps **turn ideas or photos into a playable character** and bring it to life through conversations and stories.
